signals.rationale: The speaker exhibits physical signs of tension, including a noticeable swallow and a slight lip lick before answering. His speech is also broken up with a pause and the filler word 'um' as he formulates his response.

The speaker stands upright with an open posture and maintains steady eye contact with the off-camera listener. His voice is clear and steady, and he delivers his statement fluently without any filler words or hesitation.
